purpose: A new, isolated fixed-parameter replay of the surviving historical transfer implementation, NOT recovered historical predictions or confidence intervals for the old AUCs.
instrumentation_only: Capture prepared patient ordering and model objects before the original returns

bootstrap.unit: target patient, all admissions retained together
bootstrap.scope: conditional on newly refitted fixed source model; no model-training uncertainty

fitting: Original nominal 43 slots, original all-record median aggregation, original median imputer fitted ONLY on source, original 300-round XGBoost and 300-tree RF ensemble. No unit correction, relabelling, timing repair or target-side imputation fitting.
identity_gate: Matching a rounded AUC, or even all four rounded AUCs, does not certify original prediction identity without an archived vector/model and run-bound input/environment evidence.
patient_level_outputs: Local private/ directory only; no patient identifiers in aggregate reports or logs
